title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E20 — Songs In The Key Of Strife
Moesha houses a beautiful French exchange student.  Q picks the French girl and Kim to be back-up singers in his new band.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E21 — Hakeem’s Birthday
Moesha wants to throw Hakeem a surprise birthday party and invites his estranged father.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E22 — For Better Or For Worse
Niecy meets a wonderful recent graduate now in the military.  When he asks her to marry him, she says yes!

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E6 — Ghosts in the Machine
Nicole feels guilty about lying and learns a lesson from a dream. Professional basketball player JULIUS "DR. J" ERVING guest stars as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E7 — Waterworld
Mark's stubborn attempts to fix the plumbing fail miserably.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E8 — I Remember Grandpa
Mark has to go clean his grandfather's cabin, and he and Geneva realize they have different memories of the place. MARK CURRY plays a dual role as Mark and his grandfather.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E9 — R.E.S.P.E.C.T
Geneva and Vanessa move out when Mark treats them poorly, but he soon learns what it feels like.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E10 — The Great Pretender
Mark uses Vanessa's medical shoulder brace to get sympathy from a beautiful woman, but the charade gets out of control.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E11 — Christmas '95
A trip to a nostalgic tree farm is ruined for Mark and his friends until they all learn the true meaning of Christmas.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E12 — Increase the Peace
Earvin is challenged by a gang member, and Mark intervenes. Raven appears in this episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E13 — Robo Golf
Mark makes a risky investment. MARK LINN-BAKER guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E14 — Coach Counselor
Mark loses his office and Geneva promises him another--for a price.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E15 — Talent Show
Mark's a hero when he gets a famous musical group to promise to perform at the school carnival--until they fail to show up. TYRESE guest stars as Darrell.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E16 — Globetrotters
THE HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS (themselves) are playing in town, but Mark might have to miss them.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E17 — Rivals
Mark's competition with a rival coach escalates to a life-threatening degree. JAMIE FOXX guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E18 — The Curse
Mark doesn't believe the great car he just bought is haunted--until bad luck starts happening to him and everyone around him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E19 — Grumpy Old Man
Mark plays matchmaker to an elderly couple so he can buy a classic car. Geneva worries that no one on the faculty likes her.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E20 — True Confessions
When Vanessa dates a successful, handsome man (WILLIE GAULT), Mark has an unexpected reaction.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E21 — Breaking Up is Hard to Do
Mark and Vanessa date each other, but their relationship encounters trouble immediately.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E22 — Will She Or Won't She?
Mark mistakenly thinks that Eric has proposed to Vanessa so he asks her to marry him. Mark revokes the proposal when he discovers his mistake, but proposes to her again seriously on a scoreboard at a NBA game. Tim Hardaway and Gary Payton guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S5 E1 — The Ring
After convincing Vanessa to marry him, Mark must buy her an engagement ring.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E1 — The Wild, Wild Webst
Webster fantasizes that he is a hero in the Wild West defeating a bully.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.
